gpt-6-astra.skip_reason: Not run, on cost. At $10 in and $50 out per million tokens it costs about 2.5 times Opus 5.5 and 100 times Haiku 5.5, and the full matrix would add roughly $30. It could not change the decision: the default rule picks the cheapest setting within 5 points of the best verified pass rate, so the most expensive model only wins by beating every cheaper one by more than 5 points, and OpenAI models are for evals only, so it would not ship either way.
